tool.name: PredictLandcover

param.name: model_file
param.dialogReference: Trained model file in .joblib format created by the Train Landcover Model tool. The model file contains the trained algorithm and information about the required input features. Ensure the model was trained on raster data with the same bands as your input raster.

param.name: scaler_file
param.dialogReference: Corresponding scaler file (.joblib) for feature normalisation. This file was created during the model training phase.

param.name: input_raster
param.dialogReference: Raster dataset to classify. Must have the same number and order of bands as the raster used for model training. This can be the same raster used for training or a new raster covering a different area with the same band configuration.

param.name: output_raster
param.dialogReference: Output raster dataset containing classification results. Each pixel will be assigned an integer value representing its predicted landcover class. The output can be in any raster format supported by ArcGIS (TIFF, GRID, etc.).

param.name: model_type
param.dialogReference: Model type that matches the trained model (Random Forest, XGBoost, or CatBoost)

tool.summary:
This tool applies a previously trained model to classify an entire raster dataset. It processes the raster in chunks to manage memory usage and creates a classified output raster where each pixel is assigned to a landcover class.

The tool handles large rasters efficiently through chunked processing and can classify multi-band imagery using any model trained with the Train Landcover Model tool.
tool.usage:
Use this tool after training a model with the Train Landcover Model tool. The input raster must have the same bands (in the same order) as the raster used for training.

For large rasters:

  • Reduce chunk size if encountering memory errors

  • Increase chunk size for faster processing if memory allows

  • Processing time depends on raster size and model complexity
